name: tg-secret-core
description: Telegram secret chats (end-to-end encrypted) for Node.js, with encrypted local storage and YubiKey / Windows Hello / Touch ID unlock
author: Zaur Lumanov

scripts.coverage: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --conditions=tg-secret-source --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/** --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info test/*.test.ts
